public_rationale: The biography and relation-learning studies support important parts of the reliability criticism. The categorical five-digit multiplication claim is contradicted by a contemporary fine-tuned LLM's reported 96.7% accuracy. Chess results and Waymo's driving comparison also qualify the sweeping wording, although neither is decisive under the contract's scope and reliability requirements. Counting and several other components remain unsettled; mixed does not mean the entire list has been resolved.
limitations: The multiplication contradiction includes fine-tuned LLMs; narrowing the claim to an unaided general-purpose GPT-4 setup would change that component.
Reading 'can't' as an unstated reliability qualification would require a different threshold.
The evidence does not establish that any system combined all these capabilities with human-comparable general intelligence.
Several components remain only partially tested.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Current machines can't count or do five-digit multiplication, can't reliably generalize kinship relations or reliably follow the rules of chess, can't obey the dictum 'don't make stuff up' when writing a biography or a new story, and the authors have yet to see them drive cars as well as the average human adult.

statement.excerpt: They can’t count, do five digit multiplication, reliably generalize kinship relations, or even reliably follow the rules of chess, and so on—despite the fact that each of these activities is presumably well explained, explicitly, in the training set, They also can’t, for example, obey the dictum “don’t make stuff up”, when they write a biography or a new story, and we have yet to see them drive cars as well as the average human adult.
statement.document_title: Reports of the birth of AGI are greatly exaggerated

our_interpretation: Assess the listed components separately. Mixed is appropriate if evidence supports some and contradicts others.
Preserve the wording's distinction: counting and multiplication are categorical capability claims; kinship and chess explicitly concern reliability.
Read the cognitive-task claims as concerning contemporary LLMs, including fine-tuned LLMs, rather than ordinary calculators or conventional chess engines.
Interpret factual writing as writing presented as true; inventing a fictional story is not a factual error.

Treat the driving clause as a statement about publicly demonstrated capability, not a verifiable report of the authors' private awareness. Specialized driving systems are contextual evidence when assessing LLM capabilities.
Use 2023 through the post date as the current research period. The earlier discussion is treated as reapplied in this post.
The word 'presumably' does not establish what any particular model's training data contained.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporary tests substantiate the asserted inability or unreliability in each named component under its stated scope. Whole-claim support requires evidence covering the bundle, not just one failure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Demonstrated counting or five-digit multiplication contradicts the respective categorical inability claim. Reliable kinship or legal-chess performance, consistently factual writing, or appropriately matched driving evidence would contradict the corresponding qualified component.

evidence.explanation: Human evaluation found many unsupported atomic statements in generated biographies. This supports the factual-writing reliability concern; the metric does not mean every unsupported statement was proven false.

The reported asymmetry concerns identifying a celebrity's parent versus identifying the parent's child. Together with controlled relation-learning experiments, it supports a specific generalization weakness, without establishing failure on every kinship task.

evidence.excerpt: exactly the same questions and prompts.
evidence.publisher: Liu and Low, National University of Singapore, arXiv
evidence.explanation: Table 3 reports 96.7% exact-match accuracy for Goat-7B on five-digit-by-five-digit multiplication, versus 0.0% for the tested GPT-4 setup. A fine-tuned LLM could therefore perform the task, contradicting the categorical inability claim while preserving a limitation of that GPT-4 setup.

The evaluator reported a very low illegal-move rate for GPT-3.5-turbo-instruct and frequent illegal-move losses for GPT-4. The explicit warning about insufficient recording and state validation prevents treating the precise legality rate as a decisive contradiction.

evidence.publisher: Di Lillo et al., Swiss Re and Waymo, arXiv
evidence.explanation: The study reported fewer liability claims for Waymo's rider-only operation than matched human baselines. This is material counterevidence to a broad machine-driving dismissal, but concerns a specialized system and a safety measure within its operating domain, not unrestricted driving by an LLM.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Dated, reproducible tests of the relevant 2023 models on counting, broader kinship reasoning, validated chess legality and factual news writing would settle the remaining cognitive components. Driving needs an explicit system scope and comparison domain.
